event: 2025 ILCA 4 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
facts: During the arbitration meeting, POL 220730 took a 30% post race penalty.
GRE 214206 asked to withdraw the protest.
Subsequently GRE 214206 asked to withdraw the request for redress.
conclusions: There is no reason to refuse the request to withdraw the request of redress.
decision: POL 220730 took a 30% post race penalty. The arbitrator on behalf of the protest committee allows the protest to be withdrawn.
The panel of the international jury allows the request to redress to be withdrawn.
